items.source: The application does not need to do anything to rollback the transaction.
items.translation: 应用程序无需执行任何操作来回滚事务。

items.source: The transaction failed and unambiguously did not commit. No actors can see any part of this failed transaction.
items.translation: 交易失败且明确未提交。没有任何参与者能看到该失败交易的任何部分。
